# NetLine UI v8.0.0-rc.2 - Overview

## Introduction

NetLine UI is the code library of NetLine Design System, which is created to provide unified and comprehensive UI 
interface for NetLine products. It is built with React Material UI (MUI) and provides a set of reusable
components, styles, and utilities to help developers create consistent and user-friendly interfaces for NetLine 
applications.

The design system aims to improve the user experience across all NetLine products by providing a consistent look and 
feel, as well as a set of best practices for UI design and development. By using NetLine UI, developers can save time 
and effort in building UI components from scratch, while also ensuring that their applications adhere to the design 
principles and guidelines.

The NetLine Design System is documented in detail in 
<a href="https://brand.lhsystems.com/hub/387" target="frontify" onClick="">NetLine Design System Frontify documentation page </a>
which provides guidelines on typography, color schemes, iconography, and other design elements. 

The components designs are defined in 
<a href="https://www.figma.com/design/lApbjbZQZ79K9FJRJmhE7y/Component-library-%7C-NL" target="figma" onClick="">this Figma file </a>
and implemented in this code library using Typescript and React. 

The library is an internal open-source project of Lufthansa Systems, Ltd. and available in the **lsy-netline** 
organization on <a href="https://github.com/netline-ui/netline-ui" target="github-repo" onClick="">GitHub</a>.

## Used technologies

The NetLine UI code library is built using the following technologies:
- **React**: A JavaScript library for building user interfaces.
- **Typescript**: A superset of Javascript that adds static typing and other features
- **Material UI (MUI)**: A popular React UI framework that provides a set of pre-designed components and styles.
- **Storybook**: A tool for developing and documenting UI components in isolation.
- **Nx Monorepo**: A set of tools for managing and developing multiple projects in a single repository.
- **Jest**: A testing framework for JavaScript and TypeScript applications.
- **ESLint**: A tool for identifying and fixing code quality issues in JavaScript and TypeScript code.
- **Prettier**: A code formatter that helps maintain consistent code style across the codebase.
- **Husky**: A tool for managing Git hooks and enforcing code quality standards.
- **GitHub Actions**: A CI/CD platform for automating build, test, and deployment workflows.
- **Conventional Commits**: A specification for writing standardized commit messages that can be used to automate 
  versioning and changelog generation.

The design system documentation and design assets are created and managed using the following tools:
- **Frontify**: A design system documentation platform used to document the NetLine Design System guidelines.
- **Figma**: A collaborative design tool used to create and manage the design assets for the NetLine Design System.

## Reporting an Issue

NetLine UI is managed in trackSpace under [UICDLSY](https://trackspace.lhsystems.com/projects/UICDLSY/issues) project. 
Please open a bug or story ticket in case you experience something is not working correctly, or you have a new idea, 
component / technical change request, etc.

The created ticket must contain the following topics:
- Actual Behaviour: where the problematic workflow is described (can be extended with images)
- Expected Behaviour: a description what is expected, how the component, hook, etc. should work
- Steps to Reproduce (for bugs only): step-by-step reproduction guide (images, videos also welcomed here)

Optionally, any context and environment information can be specified which can affect the reproduction of the issue.

It is possible that NetLine UI Team will find you personally for clarification.
